english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to describe doing something in a euphoric or highly excited manner.
Use this when the animated manner mainly comes from excitement or enthusiasm.
Choose this when the feverish manner specifically highlights excitement or eager enthusiasm.

examples.english: I shouted euphorically when I heard the winning news.
examples.traditional: 我一聽到中獎消息，就興奮咁叫咗出嚟。

examples.english: The child talked animatedly about the birthday present they received.
examples.traditional: 個小朋友興奮咁講住收到嘅生日禮物。
